title: Documented id-sweep gather: make the loop gathers (pr_files, comments) fail closed
objective: Close #349, the follow-up #348 declared. The documented pr_files loop wrote 0 bytes both for an honest empty result (now refused by #323's fix) and for a failed `gh pr list`, and a part-way failure left a non-empty partial dump the sweep READ with exit 0. Make each loop gather build a temp file, propagate every failure with an explicit `|| exit 1`, end with a declared line and move into place only on success: a failure leaves the dump MISSING (refused), an honest empty gather a non-empty declared dump (READ 0). Carry the WP-2026-0152 reconcile.
business_value: The documented procedure stops being refused on every run with no open PRs, and the one remaining path to a confidently wrong next-free -- a partial gather READ as complete -- is closed, in a repository that has had three id collisions in one session.
in_scope: docs/governance/GITHUB_CONTROL_PLANE.md: the pr_files and comments gathers in the id-allocation block fail closed (temp file, explicit `|| exit 1`, declared line, mv on success), with a paragraph naming the two shortcuts that reintroduce #323 (unconditional declaration; `( set -e; ... ) && mv`, where bash ignores set -e)
